title: Wildlife Learning and Conservation Center
specs: Home to over 100 displaced, rescued, and zoo-born wild animals
Participates in Species Survival Plans for two-toed sloth, 3-banded armadillo, and North American porcupine
Adventure Tour recommended for guests 5 and older
Interns must be at least 18 years old
Interns must be in good physical health and capable of lifting 50 lbs
Interns must commit minimum 3 months or 36 days, three 8-hour days per week including one weekend day
Tours have a maximum capacity of 7 guests total
Adventure Tour price is for up to 5 participants; additional participants charged separately

blurb: Guests can participate in onsite tours to meet and feed various animals, individual animal experiences for close encounters, and outreach programs for schools. The center cares for over 100 rescued and zoo-born wild animals and participates in species conservation efforts. Internships are available for those interested in gaining zoo husbandry experience.
extraNote: Advanced reservations required for onsite tours · Individual animal experiences cannot be reserved in advance · Species Spotlight program offers 14-day full refund if not satisfied
